decision.reason: [ev-e730a0f53228] is a single changelog line. It says memory units were added to "panels showing memory usage" in a Grafana dashboard, but it does not name the dashboard file, the panels or any field path that would identify the subject. It also says nothing about which installations are exposed, for example whether only operators who import the bundled dashboard are affected. For details it only points to PR #22078. That PR or the dashboard diff is needed to pin down the subject and applicability.
